Account: QueryPilot Labs — mid-market SaaS that builds a semantic search layer for developer docs and product content. Evaluating Redwood Hosted API first (quick POC) then move to Dedicated for production search/indexing.

Requirements / constraints (customer stated):
- Workload: nightly bulk embedding pipeline (~100k-200k docs), plus real-time semantic search queries during business hours (~200 qps peak across regions).
- Throughput targets: embed ingestion target 100-200 embeds/sec sustained during batch window; query latency SLO <120ms for top-k retrieval (including vector DB hop).
- Vector DB: currently using Pinecone for index + MMR; will evaluate switching to self-hosted vector DB depending on cost. Needs easy connector to Redwood outputs (embeddings) and batching support.
- Cost sensitivity: mid-market constraints — wants predictable per-embedding pricing and lower unit costs when moving to Dedicated.
- Security: SSO/SAML, audit logging, and KMS for key management required for prod. Data residency: must keep EU customer subset in eu region (regional routing required).

POC details and findings:
- Hosted API POC (Feb): quick to integrate, good developer DX. Pros: faster time-to-value, no infra overhead. Cons: burst throttling during large batch attempted; token/embedding unit costs higher than target.
- Integration with Pinecone worked with Redwood-hosted embeddings via async batch endpoints. Observed ~120 embeds/sec; customer wants headroom to 200 embeds/sec to finish nightly windows within SLA.
- Latency: single-query P99 ~110ms (hosted + Pinecone) in NA; EU tests show slight variance due to region routing.
- Quality: embeddings quality comparable to baseline OpenAI runs in customer evals.

Customer interests in Redwood Dedicated:
- Predictable throughput for nightly jobs, ability to reserve capacity and avoid throttling during indexing.
- Cost model: reserved capacity + burst for occasional spikes. Wants a sample pricing scenario for 200 embeds/sec sustained overnight.
- Routing: regional routing to pin EU indexing to eu region.

- Security questionnaire in progress; customer wants SOC2 report + sample audit log outputs. (Security team engaged).
- Legal: MSA / Data Processing Addendum required for EU residency.
